means: The danbooru crop tag for chest-or-waist up: head, shoulders and arms in frame, legs gone.
does: Sets the standard dialogue and reaction distance. Close enough that mouth, brows and eye tags are drawn at real size and actually land, wide enough that a gesture still reads. In the shot_purpose sweep the dialogue panel ("upper body, open mouth, talking") came back as a clean chest-up framing, clearly separated from both the wides and the close-ups. Same crop family as full body and close-up - only one of them wins per prompt.
reach_for_it: the default for anyone talking or reacting. Reach for it before close-up, which is stronger than most beats need.
used_in: the dialogue clause of shot.purpose ("upper body, open mouth, talking") and the reaction clause of shot.framing_type ("upper body, wide-eyed, open mouth")
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short black hair, dark jacket, standing on a rooftop, city skyline behind, late afternoon sun, looking away, masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
